you_should_know.title: Federal operation targeted progressive groups, unions in Minnesota
you_should_know.summary: Homeland Security officers were spying on community meetings during Operation Metro Surge, the federal enforcement push in the Minneapolis-St. Paul area, according to court documents. The federal agents went undercover to identify people they described as violent, the filings said. As Conor Wight shows, the surveillance targeted progressive groups and labor unions.

you_should_know.title: Minnesota farmers navigate worsening drought conditions
you_should_know.summary: Minnesota's drought is getting worse. The latest conditions show nearly half the state is dealing with severe drought conditions. That includes part of the Minneapolis-St. Paul metro area. Photojournalist Ray Campos and Frankie McLister show how it's impacting Minnesota farmers.
